johnisanerd-claude-skill-account-mapping.description: Account mapping that lists the current people at your target accounts by role and city, from LinkedIn's public pages. Use when someone says map the buying committee at these accounts, find the decision makers at my target accounts, account mapping for sales, build a target account list, talent mapping, who works on a competitor's team, get a company employee list by job title, or crm hygiene for the contacts we hold at an account. Finds or confirms the accounts (a Google search of LinkedIn company pages, then LinkedIn firmographics), lists current employees by title and city with each…
johnisanerd-claude-skill-account-mapping.author: John Cole
